joining_perks: The joining fee for the ICICI Bank Coral Credit Card is Rs.500.
reward_structure:
- Transaction worth Rs. 2 Lakh is rewarded 2000 points under the ICICI Bank's reward program. Post this mark, 1000 points will be given for transactions which are above Rs 1 Lakh during anniversary year.
- The upper limit on PAYBACK Points is 50,000 per annum.
- A cardholder can gain PAYBACK points for every purchase of Rs. 100. This is valid for payments excluding fuel.
- One can obtain 1 PAYBACK point on payments for utilities and insurance.
key_highlights:
- With the ICICI Bank Coral Credit Card, one can earn up to 10,000 payback points every year.
- You also enjoy complimentary access to the airport and railway lounges and movie tickets. Above all, you receive at least 2000 cashback points every year.

benefits_features.Travel benefits: A discount of 25% is offered on booking movie tickets with BookMyShow and Paytm.
benefits_features.Dining benefits: 15% discounts on dining through Culinary Trevails
benefits_features.Lounge benefits:
- Complimentary access to Airport Lounges across
- Complimentary access to Railway Lounges
benefits_features.Renewal benefits: The annual fee for the second year onwards is Rs.500

how_tos.How to redeem ICICI Bank Coral Credit Ca:
- Gifts: After accumulating reward points, you can check where you want to redeem your points on the ICICI website. There is an option to redeem your points. You will be guided on the PAYBACK website for choosing a category from among the products according to the points you have.
- Shopping: PAYBACK has partnered with stores like Big Bazaar, Pantaloons, Central and others. Ask to use your PAYBACK points and range your option.
- Shopping online: You can redeem your points at any of the payment websites like makemytrip.com, tata.com, bookmyshow.com and more. Under payment option, select PAYBACK and enter points detail to redeem your points.
- Cash: You can redeem your points for cash. Each equivalent of 32 points can be deducted indicating the number and the amount will be credited to your credit account within 7 working days. You can redeem up to 50,000 points. Call PAYBACK, this is your total redeemable amount.

miscellaneous:
ICICI Culinary Trails Programme
Cardholders can recover discounts of about 50% while dining over 2,000 restaurants across 12 cities in our country.Exclusive access to Airport and Railway Lounges
Every quarter the card allows users to gain complimentary access to select domestic airport lounges or railway lounges. The complimentary lounge access can be availed only by the main cardholder.Secured transactions
The Coral Credit Card is modeledwith a microchip which acts as an added protection against malicious use of the card.
A user is required to enter the Personal Identification Number (PIN) for transactions on card swipe machines.
A case of online purchase, one does not need to enter the PIN.
In order to read the 16-digit Secure code, a cardholder must register the card through the official ICICI website.Waiver on fuel surcharges
A user of the Coral Credit Card can get a waiver of 1% on fuel surcharges. This can be availed for a purchase of a maximum transaction of Rs.4000.The waiver is applicable on card payments through ICICI, Merchant Service, Card swipe machines.

faqs.How do I avail fuel surcharge waivers on: The offer is available at HPCL, BPCL, and IOCL. The minimum transaction amount is Rs.4000 for a waiver of 1% on fuel surcharges. The payment should be made by swiping the card at the ICICI Merchant Service swipe machine only.
faqs.How can I avail discounts at restaurants: To avail discounts (please refer to the offers page of the ICICI Bank Coral Credit Card) while settling the bill.
